description: This source file implements the platform-dependent and utility functions for a Daemon Engine TCP object within the ANSC framework. It includes licensing information, module description, and the implementation of the factory function 'AnscCreateDaemonEngineTcp' which creates and returns an object of the Daemon Engine TCP.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateDaemonEngineTcp(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Factory method that creates and returns an instance of the Daemon Engine TCP object, taking container, owner, and reserved context handles as parameters.
